title: Make the live Habits tracker set user-configurable
mission: Use the exact gh-pages calendar/habits surface as preserve-first donor and replace the hardcoded Habits tracker roster with a user-configurable tracker model that survives reloads without losing existing behavior-event history or weakening the current IndexedDB + mirror/outbox persistence path.
definition_of_done: Start from gh-pages pages/calendar/previews/habits-traces-v1/ and preserve the existing Calendar / Habits / Money shell rather than rebuilding it.
Allow a user to add, rename, classify and archive a habit/tracker from the Habits surface; do not require editing source constants.
Migrate the current fixed tracker ids and their existing behavior-event history without data loss; archived trackers remain recoverable/exportable.
Keep the current persistence authority boundary: IndexedDB when available, durable local mirror/outbox fallback when it is not.
Do not seed or expose personal/sensitive tracker labels as mandatory defaults for a new user; preserve existing user data when present.
Produce an isolated candidate and verify reload persistence plus add/rename/archive behavior before any Catalog/Current/Served change.
Do not mutate Human Accepted, Current or Served pointers as part of this job.
